sentences.text:
The present bail application has been filed on behalf of the petitioner who is in custody in
connection with Fir No.93/2016, Police Station Bagoda, District Jalore for the offence punishable
under Sections 420, 406, 409 & 120-B of Ipc.
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor.
Perused the material available on record.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the principal accused Heer Singh has been enlarged on bail by the co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 05.12.2016.
He further submits that other accused persons, namely Ratan Singh & Narpat Singh have also been enlarged on bail vide orders dated 16.08.2018 & 25.10.2018 respectively.
The charge-sheet in the case has been filed.

Learned counsel submits that the case of the [2024:RJ-JD:41144] (2 of 2)
[CRLMB-9814/2024] present petitioner is not distinguishable from the case of co- accused persons who have already been released on bail.
He, therefore, prays that the petitioner may also be enlarged on bail.

sentences.text: The learned Public Prosecutor opposes the bail application but he is unable to distinguish the case of the present petitioner vis-a-vis the case of the co-accused persons who have been enlarged on bail.

5. Having regard to the peculiar facts and circumstances of the case and considering the fact that case of the present petitioner is identical to the co-accused aforesaid who have been enlarged on bail, this Court deems it just and proper to release the petitioner on bail.
6. Consequently, the present bail application is allowed.

It is ordered that the accused-petitioner Bhanwar Singh S/o Shri Bal Singh arrested in connection with FIR No.93/2016, Police Station Bagoda, District Jalore, shall be released on bail; provided he furnishes a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees: Fifty Thousand Only) with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees: Twenty Five Thousand Only) each to the satisfaction of the learned trial court with the stipulation to appear before that Court on all dates of hearing and as and when called upon to do so.
(VINIT KUMAR MATHUR),J 62-Shahenshah/-
